scientific_conclusion: The implemented projected-Shakhov collision target matches an independently coded evaluation of the paper equations to below 1e-12 after the exact coordinate transformation. The unclipped target closes conserved moments and heat-flux relaxation to 5.89e-10 and 1.38e-8, respectively. The retained 0.05 factor clipping and density renormalization are implementation-faithful but introduce material defects: up to 3.1615% in a conserved moment and 17.2460% in heat-flux closure, with four of five frozen states materially clipped. This is a positive equation-equivalence result and a negative physical-conservation result; it does not validate the cavity benchmark or justify retuning.
scientifically_justified_next_scope: Audit a homogeneous collision-only source update against independently integrated moment-relaxation identities on the same five frozen states. Keep the retained clipped target as the active arm, and retain unclipped and bounded-conservative targets as explicitly labeled diagnostics only, with no solver, physics, quadrature, floor, normalization or cross-Knudsen retuning.
